text:
rachel: scheduling dedicated rollout for tenant PrysmCare. Quiet window 2026-05-10 01:00-03:00 UTC. Plan: dry-run priming -> 10% canary (20m) -> 50% (20m) -> drain & final. Image pinned: `relay-3.3.0` primary, fallback `relay-3.2.1`. KV prime: isolated synthetic traffic 12m before canary. tagging eng-ops + sec-bot for signoff.

deploy-bot: scheduled job pry-1766664321 at 2026-05-10T01:05:00Z (id cb-1766664321). Will post metric samples every 4m and debug traces on failure.

marc: ack. set gates: p95 < 195ms AND errors < 0.45% for two consecutive samples to proceed. also require tokens/s >= 88% baseline before moving to 50%.

priya: eng-ops ack and i'll be watching mem/GPU reservation. add autopause: pause if p95 > 230ms OR errors > 1% for any 2 consecutive samples.

sec-bot: audit logging ON. KMS maintenance none scheduled. ops-bot toggled tenant.prysm.audit=true.

deploy-bot: dry-run priming started at 2026-05-10T00:50:00Z (synthetic 15k reqs). observed short eviction spike ~45s then stable.

deploy-bot: canary started at 2026-05-10T01:05:30Z (run cb-1766664321-run1). metrics (4m): p50=40ms, p95=168ms, errors=0.18%, tokens/s=90% baseline.

marc: good first sample. hold to confirm second sample.

deploy-bot: metrics (8m): p50=42ms, p95=182ms, errors=0.37%, tokens/s=89% baseline. Gate satisfied for 50% progression.

priya: advancing to 50% per plan. enabling additional logging for /v1/chat route during expansion.

deploy-bot: progressed to 50% at 2026-05-10T01:29:00Z. metrics (4m): p50=45ms, p95=190ms, errors=0.51%, tokens/s=87% baseline.

marc: error rate breached gate (0.51% > 0.45%). autopause needs 2 consecutive breaches to stop. we have 1 breach. hold at 50% while investigating.

priya: running targeted traces for 5% of failing requests, increasing retry log level. looks like an upstream routing transient causing 429s clustered to one shard.

rachel: do we want to fallback to relay-3.2.1 now or wait one more sample? what's the impact on customers?

marc: impact limited but we should not progress to final. recommend wait one more sample; if breach persists initiate rollback. set emergency rollback command below.

rachel: emergency rollback CLI:
```
/rollout rollback --tenant prysmcare --to relay-3.2.1 --reason "canary error spike" --ticket PRY-204
```
react :eyes: to acknowledge.

priya: :eyes: i'll keep monitoring memory pressure and request fanout.

sec-bot: :eyes: audit logs will capture rollback flag if used.

deploy-bot: metrics (4m): p50=43ms, p95=179ms, errors=0.33%, tokens/s=90% baseline. breach cleared.

marc: breach cleared. require one more stable sample before final ramp.

deploy-bot: metrics (4m): p50=41ms, p95=175ms, errors=0.29%, tokens/s=92% baseline.

rachel: two good samples confirmed. proceeding to drain & final rollout outside quiet window. will publish release note with pinned images, gating thresholds, KV prime behavior, debug trace summary, and rollback command. thanks all.

ops-bot: release note created: https://redwood.internal/releases/prysmcare/relay-3.3.0-canary-notes (internal).

deploy-bot: canary job cb-1766664321 completed SUCCESS at 2026-05-10T02:49:58Z.
